A1.justification: Both complete 22-page PDFs describe ProtoTS and contain the same main scientific sections, Appendices A–G, six figures, and eleven tables. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the scientific and presentation content.

before.justification: v3 reports original forecasting experiments, component ablations, a 24-participant interpretability study, and expert prototype-editing results in Section 4, with further experimental results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains original forecasting, ablation, user-study, and expert-editing outcomes, including Tables 1–8 and Figure 4. These remain original empirical results despite being retained from v3.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same multichannel embeddings, bottleneck fusion, prototype matching, hierarchical splitting, and forecasting/entropy loss. Algorithm 1 is relocated without changing its procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same four LOF regions, five EPF markets, and six multivariate benchmarks: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, ETTm2, Weather, and Exchange. The interpretability and expert-steering scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the forecasting tables, seed analyses, and Appendix G. The user study still compares ProtoTS with TFT and NBEATSx, and the prediction visualizations retain TimeXer and iTransformer. Newly added citations do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Both retain LOF look-back/forecast windows of 384/96, EPF windows of 168/24, and Appendix G's 96-step inputs and four forecast horizons. Training settings, preprocessing, metrics, and the 24-user randomized model-presentation design are unchanged.

E4.justification: The three component ablations in Table 3, prototype-count and training-data sensitivity analyses in Figure 3, expert-editing case study in Figure 4, and prediction comparisons in Figure 6 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report five-seed means and standard deviations in Appendix C.3 and Tables 7–8, the same UPrec uncertainty notation in Table 4, and five-seed averaging for Figure 4. No statistical procedure or run-count change is reported.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, ProtoTS retains average LOF MSE/MAE of 0.031/0.106 in Table 5 and EPF values of 0.241/0.218 in Table 6; Figure 4 retains the expert-editing MSE reduction from 0.099 to 0.090.

T1.justification: The forecasting formulation, embedding and similarity definitions, hierarchical prediction equations, and loss in Equations 1–9 are unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, proof, or derivation is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims of accurate forecasting, holistic and multilevel interpretation, and expert steerability. The claimed novelty of decoding prototypes into output sequences is also unchanged.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are retained. Appendix F still identifies limitations involving irregular temporal patterns, dependence on domain experts, and computational overhead; its added citation does not alter these limitations.

D1.justification: v4 adds an explicit source-code repository link to the abstract, absent in v3 despite its reproducibility statement. It removes that statement's descriptions of available data, scripts, configurations, and seeds. Appendix B's implementation details remain unchanged; actual repository contents cannot be established from the PDFs.

R1.justification: Six references are added: Munz-Körner and Weiskopf (2024), Jin et al. (2023b), Lee et al. (2025), Xu et al. (2024), and Zhang et al. (2024a,b). They accompany existing method, evaluation, and limitation passages without substantially revising the related-work argument or novelty positioning.

P1.justification: v4 updates author order, affiliations, and contribution notes, makes limited paragraph and spelling edits, and replaces the ethics and reproducibility statements with acknowledgements. The main scientific narrative and appendix organization remain largely unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block is compacted, Algorithm 1 moves from page 7 to page 6, and existing tables and Figure 3 shift vertically as text reflows. All figures and tables are retained, with unchanged graphical content, axes, legends, and table structures.

improvement.justification: v4 supplies the code address missing from v3, improving access documentation, but removes the informed-consent disclosure and the description of available reproducibility materials. Scientific evidence and implementation details remain unchanged. These opposing transparency changes, with repository contents unverified by the supplied PDFs, prevent a reliable judgment of net overall improvement.
